stem: A regression for a phone charger gives: weekly units = 1,200 - 30 × price (€) + 400 × display, where display is 1 when the charger is on display and 0 when it is not. Week 1 has a price of €20 and no display. Week 2 has a price of €25 and the charger on display. How many more units does the model predict for week 2 than for week 1? Give a whole number of units.
